reviews.text: We needed an emergency propane delivery on a Sunday. Susquehanna propane was the only company who answered their phone. We are switching from patriot to Susquehanna for this reason. In an emergency, you can count on Susquehanna propane!
reviews.author: Jean B.

reviews.text: Saved the day on Christmas Eve. Amazing service. Polite, courteous, and super helpful.

reviews.text: I have been an oil customer for many years but recently needed a new boiler. They made the whole process easy and got the job done fast. They even waited on payment until I got my financing in order.
